"work_nature": "Compliance analysts spend a significant portion of their time translating complex regulations into actionable checks, testing whether policies are followed, and managing evidence for auditors
Work is often fragmented across disconnected tools, leading to time lost in manual data transfer between systems
"GRC Platforms (e.g., AuditBoard, OneTrust, Drata, Vanta, Optro)
"Productivity and Documentation (Microsoft Office/Excel, Google Workspace)
"Communication (Email clients, Slack)
"Specialized Compliance Software (e.g., StarCompliance, Freyr SUBMIT PRO)
"notes": "Many modern GRC platforms are cloud-based and accessible via web browsers on macOS
Some specialized tools may have specific OS compatibility requirements; users should verify native support for specific versions
Analysts frequently manage dense email chains for approvals and evidence requests
Documentation is critical, as files must be audit-ready for regulators or successors
"email_specifics": "Some compliance professionals spend 4–5 hours per week specifically on email reviews and monitoring
